::: {.callout-warning title="Preliminary model output"}

This output is preliminary and will change as the model evolves and as
further data are incorporated. If the fit used the `dev` profile rather
than `reporting`, convergence diagnostics and posterior uncertainty
bands are more approximate than a full run would give.

:::

This report summarises a fit of the three-stage Bayesian selection
model for recorded Down-syndrome livebirth ascertainment in U.S. birth
certificate data (2016–2024). The model decomposes observed recording
into:

$$
P(R = 1 \mid X) = \theta_\text{LB}(\text{age}) \cdot \eta(X) \cdot s(X)
\;+\; (1 - \theta_\text{LB}\cdot \eta) \cdot f
$$

where $\theta_\text{LB}$ is the baseline DS livebirth rate in the
absence of screening (Morris 2002 / de Graaf 2015), $\eta = 1 -
\eta_\text{detect} \cdot \eta_\text{term}$ is the screening/termination
pass-through (Kuppermann / Natoli / Chaiken), $s$ is birth-certificate
sensitivity given a DS livebirth (Boulet 2011 / Salemi 2017), and $f$
is a fixed false-positive rate (Ohio/NY validation). See
`plans/docs/bayesian_selection_model.md` for the full design.

```{python}
# | echo: false
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Image, Markdown

config = json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text())
run_config = json.loads(Path("run_config.json").read_text())
```

```{python}
# | echo: false
variant = config["variant"]
spec = config["spec"]
year_range = config["year_range"]
post_dobbs_year = config["post_dobbs_year"]
profile = run_config["name"]
sampler = run_config["nuts_sampler"]

Markdown(
    f"- **variant**: `{variant}` "
    f"({'tight s' if variant == 'A' else 'tight η_term' if variant == 'B' else 'default' if variant == 'C' else 'Dobbs-only'})\n"
    f"- **spec**: `{spec}`\n"
    f"- **year range**: {year_range[0]}–{year_range[1]}\n"
    f"- **post-Dobbs year**: {post_dobbs_year} "
    f"(year_idx ≥ {post_dobbs_year - year_range[0]} uses the wider sigma)\n"
    f"- **sampling profile**: `{profile}` "
    f"({run_config['chains']} chains × {run_config['draws']} draws, "
    f"tune={run_config['tune']}, "
    f"target_accept={run_config['target_accept']}, sampler={sampler})"
)
```

## Cell aggregation

Births within the year range with known `down_ind`, `mage_c`, and the
required covariates are aggregated into cells keyed on year × age band
× race × education × payer × preterm × CCHD × NICU × assisted-
ventilation. A state/region column is not available in the project
DuckDB, so the Dobbs shock is captured as a national year effect
(`eta_term_year`) rather than a state-level contrast.

```{python}
# | echo: false
cells = pd.read_parquet("cells.parquet")
n_total = int(cells["N_cell"].sum())
r_total = int(cells["R_cell"].sum())
pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "value": [
            len(cells),
            f"{n_total:,}",
            f"{r_total:,}",
            f"{r_total / max(n_total, 1):.3e}",
            f"{year_range[0]}–{year_range[1]}",
        ],
    },
    index=[
        "cells",
        "total livebirths (N)",
        "recorded DS (R)",
        "overall recorded rate",
        "year range",
    ],
)
```

## Convergence

```{python}
# | echo: false
summary_path = Path("summary.csv")
convergence_path = Path("convergence_summary.csv")
if summary_path.exists():
    summary = pd.read_csv(summary_path, index_col=0)
    rhat_col = "r_hat" if "r_hat" in summary.columns else "rhat"
    max_rhat = summary[rhat_col].max() if rhat_col in summary.columns else float("nan")
    ess_cols = [c for c in ("ess_bulk", "ess_tail") if c in summary.columns]
    min_ess = summary[ess_cols].min().min() if ess_cols else float("nan")
    Markdown(
        f"- **max R̂**: {max_rhat:.4f} (target < 1.01)\n"
        f"- **min ESS**: {min_ess:.0f} (target ≥ 400)"
    )
elif convergence_path.exists():
    Markdown("*(see `convergence_summary.csv`)*")
else:
    Markdown("*(prior-only run — no posterior convergence summary available)*")
```

## Age curve — Stage 1 sanity check

Posterior baseline DS livebirth rate $\theta_\text{LB}$ per 1,000
livebirths, by maternal age band, against the Morris / de Graaf prior
means. The Morris prior is tight ($\sigma = 0.10$ on logit) so
posterior means should track the anchors closely — large deviations
indicate the age coding or cell aggregation has drifted.

```{python}
# | echo: false
age_plot = Path("plots/age_curve.png")
if age_plot.exists():
    display(Image(str(age_plot)))
age_table = Path("tables/age_curve.csv")
if age_table.exists():
    display(pd.read_csv(age_table).round(3))
```

## Identifiability: η_term vs s race effects

Per-race posterior scatter of the $\eta_\text{term}$ race effect
against the $s$ race effect. A posterior correlation $|r| > 0.7$ on a
race panel indicates the decomposition is prior-driven — the data
cannot distinguish lower termination from lower birth-certificate
sensitivity. $|r| < 0.7$ suggests meaningful identification from the
data.

```{python}
# | echo: false
id_plot = Path("plots/identifiability.png")
if id_plot.exists():
    display(Image(str(id_plot)))
id_table = Path("tables/identifiability.csv")
if id_table.exists():
    id_df = pd.read_csv(id_table)
    display(id_df.assign(correlation=id_df["correlation"].round(3),
                         abs_correlation=id_df["abs_correlation"].round(3)))
```

## Dobbs year trajectory

Posterior $\eta_\text{term,year}$ trajectory with pre/post-Dobbs
colouring. The summary row in the table (`year_idx = -1`) carries
`mean(post) − mean(pre)` with its 95% credible interval — the headline
Dobbs effect under the no-region model.

```{python}
# | echo: false
dobbs_plot = Path("plots/dobbs_year_trajectory.png")
if dobbs_plot.exists():
    display(Image(str(dobbs_plot)))
dobbs_table = Path("tables/dobbs_year_trajectory.csv")
if dobbs_table.exists():
    display(pd.read_csv(dobbs_table).round(3))
```

## CCHD consistency

Posterior CCHD prevalence among true DS livebirths vs the EUROCAT
target (~22.5%). A posterior mean landing inside the target's plausible
range is evidence that the clinical-marker effects on $s$ are
well-calibrated; a systematic offset suggests the
"workup-not-complete-at-certificate-submission" mechanism differs in
magnitude from what Boulet found.

```{python}
# | echo: false
cchd_plot = Path("plots/cchd_consistency.png")
if cchd_plot.exists():
    display(Image(str(cchd_plot)))
cchd_table = Path("tables/cchd_consistency.csv")
if cchd_table.exists():
    display(pd.read_csv(cchd_table).round(4))
```

## Decomposition by race

Posterior estimate of true DS livebirths per race (stacked into
recorded vs missed), with the implied number of prenatal terminations
shown as a reference line above each bar. This is the model's
selection story in a single figure: how much of the population-level
decomposition sits in $\eta_\text{term}$ vs $s$ vs baseline.

```{python}
# | echo: false
decomposition_plot = Path("plots/decomposition_by_race.png")
if decomposition_plot.exists():
    display(Image(str(decomposition_plot)))
decomposition_table = Path("tables/decomposition_by_race.csv")

```

## Posterior predictive checks

Observed vs predicted recorded DS counts aggregated by stratum. The
posterior predictive bars should bracket the observed points (orange
markers); systematic misses in any stratum indicate missing structure.

```{python}
# | echo: false
for stratum in ("year_idx", "race_idx", "age_idx"):
    p = Path(f"plots/ppc_{stratum}.png")
    if p.exists():
        display(Image(str(p)))
```

## Caveats

- The project DuckDB has no state-level column. `eta_term_year` is a
  national year effect; Variant D's Dobbs identification is therefore a
  pre-vs-post-2022 national shift, weaker than the treated-vs-untreated
  state contrast the original design called for. Revisit when
  state-level data becomes available.
- The `dev` profile is for iteration, not reporting. Publication-
  quality posteriors require `--profile reporting`.
- The false-positive rate $f$ is fixed at 7.8e-5 (Ohio/NY) and not
  estimated. Sensitivity to $f$ requires re-fitting at a different
  constant; see `plans/docs/bayesian_selection_model.md` §8.
